text: EscAPED PRISONER 1 | was brought here from another world by spacefaring mind flayers. The ship in which | was imprisoned crashed in the mountains south of Ten-Towns. After surviving the crash, | nearly froze to death crossing the tundra to reach Ten- Towns. If some friendly trappers hadn’t found me, | would have perished. | fear some of my captors also survived the crash and might come looking for me.
